steps.input: Can I spend 1 lakh on the admission campaign now?
steps.reply:
Spending BDT 100,000 now is not safe. Even in the base forecast the most you can spend is BDT 77,000 (the limit is set by Dec W1); with BDT 100,000 you would be BDT 18,000 short of cash on payday in Dec W1 (in 16 days).
In the stress test the limit is BDT 32,000. Either cut the budget to BDT 77,000 or pay part of it later.

Recommended: Balanced (BDT 77,000). Balanced has the highest expected gain (BDT 68,690, base estimate) among plans that keep the reserve in every week of the base forecast. Aggressive would earn BDT 6,138 more on paper, but it breaks the reserve in Dec W1 by BDT 23,000 and leaves the school BDT 18,000 short of cash on payday. It loses because of that, not because it earns less.
In the stress test, paying it all now does not work. The staged schedule keeps the reserve in every week, at an extra cost of only BDT 200: Targeted banners, miking and Facebook boost BDT 26,000 (week 1); Premium wall calendars (500) BDT 20,000 (week 5); Front gate and classroom painting (phase 1) BDT 19,000 (week 4); Books and welcome kits BDT 12,000 (week 7).
Break-even: 6 extra students over 12 months; getting the cash back by the end of January needs 21. Student numbers are the owner's estimates. Shall I draft it for your approval?

steps.input: Do I need a loan for the aggressive plan?
steps.reply:
After rescheduling, BDT 10,645 is still missing. Eligibility must be confirmed before choosing; the cheapest candidate that arrives in time is Short bridge loan from the owner (all-in cost 0.0% a year).
First, without borrowing:
• Calendars and branded folders (BDT 24,000): Buy on 30-day credit from the press; lose its 1% cash discount
• Full building painting (BDT 25,000): Do this work after salaries are paid (from the week after payday)
• Extra book stock and decorations (BDT 13,000): Buy closer to January, when it is needed
Credit options (all costed the same way):
• Short bridge loan from the owner: 0.0% a year (arrives in time and passes the weakest-week test)
• Bank SME working-capital loan at market rate: 15.9% a year (arrives in time and passes the weakest-week test)
• NGO-MFI microenterprise loan (declining balance): 24.0% a year (arrives in time and passes the weakest-week test)
Before choosing a loan, one question: Does the school have a current trade licence?

steps.input: What documents does a bank loan under the CMSME refinance scheme need?
steps.reply: Bank working-capital loan under Bangladesh Bank's CMSME refinance fund usually needs: Application letter; Current trade licence; TIN certificate; National ID of owner and guarantor; CIB (credit bureau) undertaking; Financial statements for last year and this year, with a projection; Bank statements. Checklist only. FinEdvise does not apply for loans or contact lenders.

I can't do that. This app has no ability to do this: it cannot move money, change or delete records, contact people or apply for loans. Instead: I can draft a budget proposal; payments are made by the owner outside this app.

steps.input: ভর্তির প্রচারণায় এখন কত টাকা খরচ করতে পারি?
steps.reply:
এখন নিরাপদে খরচ করা যায় সর্বোচ্চ ৳47,000 (মূল পূর্বাভাস; সীমা ঠিক করছে ডিসেম্বর সপ্তাহ-2)। স্ট্রেস টেস্টে (2027 ভর্তি ও পুনঃভর্তি 15% কম, ফি 1 সপ্তাহ দেরিতে) সীমা ৳6,000।
এর বেশি খরচ করলে কোনো সপ্তাহের শেষে নগদ ৳50,000 রিজার্ভের নিচে নামবে। প্রচারণা থেকে যে টাকা আসতে পারে তা এই হিসাবে ধরা হয়নি।
এটি আগে অনুমোদিত ৳77,000 খরচের পরের হিসাব।
